briefing.headline: RHI rockets 35.6% as niche metal surge fuels gains
briefing.summary: Overnight the mega‑cap tech group showed mixed signals, with a slight net decline of 0.13% and four out of ten core names advancing. The overall market breadth was moderate, with six decliners versus four advancers, suggesting uneven sentiment ahead of the US open.
